capabilities: Render task checkbox characters as styled bullets
Draw signifier characters with symbols and colors
Define custom bullets and signifiers in settings
Switch bullets and signifiers from a menu or command
Write a notation legend to AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md
disambiguation: Not a bullet-list or outline formatter; it only changes how the character inside a task checkbox is drawn.
extras: Bullets are stored as plain characters inside task checkboxes, so notes stay compatible with other apps and plugins; the AI legend is optional and only appends to AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.
intentEvidence: Turn task checkboxes into paper-style bullets, and combine them freely with signifiers.
problem: Task checkboxes only distinguish done from not done, so there is no visual way to mark in-progress, migrated, dropped or event states.

relations.evidence: The Tasks plugin: its query results show your bullets and signifiers too

summary: Renders task checkbox characters as customizable paper-style bullets and signifiers while keeping notes plain Markdown.
